title: Repairs a variable-driven JavaScript to Python data pipeline
prompt: Run sh pipeline.sh; it is expected to fail. Use its output to repair both seeded bugs, editing only lib/score.mjs and summarize.py: the JavaScript score must scale raw values by SCORE_SCALE, and Python render() must order rows by name ascending. Then run sh pipeline.sh again and confirm it passes with REPORT_PREFIX='night shift' and SCORE_SCALE=3. Do not modify generate.mjs, verify.py, or pipeline.sh. Reply with exactly PIPELINE_REPAIRED.

files.verify.py:
import json
from pathlib import Path

from summarize import render

with open("out/report.json", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    payload = json.load(handle)
assert payload == {
    "prefix": "night shift",
    "rows": [
        {"name": "beta", "score": 6},
        {"name": "alpha", "score": 12},
    ],
}, payload
assert render(payload) == "night shift:alpha=12\nnight shift:beta=6"
Path(".passed").write_text("ok\n", encoding="utf-8")
print("PIPELINE PASS")
files.pipeline.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
rm -f .passed
REPORT_PREFIX='night shift' SCORE_SCALE=3 node generate.mjs
python3 verify.py
